program_name: International Marketing, Management and Organization (Italian official name identical: 'International marketing, management and organization') - Laurea Magistrale / Master's Degree, 2 years, 120 ECTS
teaching_language: English. The programme is delivered entirely in English ('Corso erogato in inglese' in the Manifesto degli studi 2026/27; the programme page states 'a learning experience entirely taught in English'). UNIUD lists it among the 'Master's degree courses taught entirely in English'.
campus: Udine (sede di Udine). Department of Economics and Statistics (DIES), Via Tomadini 30, 33100 Udine. Student office: Segreteria Studenti Economia, Via Tomadini 30, Udine.
degree_class: LM-77 (Scienze economico-aziendali / Management). Single class, not interclass.
access_type_detail: Accesso libero (unrestricted access). The programme page states 'Access admission unrestricted' / 'accesso libero'. In the ECONOMIA Manifesto degli studi 2026/27 the numerus-clausus ('accesso programmato', with declared seat numbers) applies only to the bachelor programmes of the Economics area; the four master's programmes, including LM-77 International Marketing, Management and Organization, are listed without any seat cap. Admission is therefore not by ranking but by verification of curricular requirements and personal preparation by the course committee. For applicants with a foreign qualification an online pre-evaluation (pre-selection) via the Elix-Forms platform is nevertheless mandatory before enrolment, and a separate non-EU quota (contingente) applies to non-EU residents abroad.
academic_requirements: Two distinct requirement sets. (A) Applicants with an ITALIAN bachelor's degree: possession of a 'laurea' or three-year university diploma, plus at least 48 CFU in the economic, business, quantitative and legal disciplinary areas, with a minimum of 24 CFU in the business (aziendale) area. The areas are defined as: ambito economico - SECS-P/01, SECS-P/02, SECS-P/03, SECS-P/04, SECS-P/05, SECS-P/06, SECS-P/12; ambito aziendale - SECS-P/07, SECS-P/08, SECS-P/09, SECS-P/10, SECS-P/11, SECS-P/13, ING-IND/35; ambito quantitativo - SECS-S/01, SECS-S/02, SECS-S/03, SECS-S/04, SECS-S/05, SECS-S/06, MAT/05, MAT/06, MAT/08, MAT/09; ambito giuridico - IUS/01, IUS/04, IUS/07, IUS/09, IUS/12. Also required: English at B2 level; knowledge of micro- and macroeconomics; general mathematics, financial mathematics and statistics; private law and commercial law; specific conceptual, technical-operational, legal and quantitative knowledge of administration and control and of management and organization; and knowledge of the specific economic vocabulary in English. Note: for a.y. 2026/27 the SSD codes refer to the pre-D.M. 639/2024 disciplinary sectors. (B) Applicants with a FOREIGN degree: 'must have completed at least a relevant Bachelor's education (i.e., bachelor degree with a major in economics, business, management)'; minimum GPA - 'The final grade of the bachelor degree must be not less than 60% of the maximum possible'; proof of English proficiency at CEFR B2. The Admissions Committee evaluates fulfilment of these requirements in addition to other relevant personal experience and competency and the ability to use English, through an online interview. The avviso adds a footnote for this programme: 'Special cases will be assessed by the evaluation committee'.
entry_exam_or_test: No written entrance exam and no TOLC/CEnT-S test (those apply only to the Economics-area bachelor programmes). Admission is by assessment of prior knowledge and personal preparation, carried out by a dedicated committee of the Course Council ('apposita commissione del Consiglio di corso di studi'). Applicants with an Italian degree who obtained a final degree mark of 90/110 or above are exempted from this assessment/interview. For applicants with a foreign qualification the assessment is an online selection interview scheduled by the Academic/Teaching Committee as part of the Elix-Forms pre-evaluation.
entry_test_name_and_deadline: Not a standardised test. (1) Italian-degree applicants: verification test or interview ('prova o colloquio') by the course committee, waived for a bachelor final mark >= 90/110; carried out within the immatricolazione window 9 July - 5 October 2026 (12:00). (2) Foreign-qualification applicants: mandatory online selection interview ('colloquio di selezione online') organised by the Commissione didattica valutatrice after submission of the Elix-Forms pre-evaluation application; the committee schedules the interview and communicates the outcome within 30 working days of submission. Application windows on Elix-Forms: 01/02/2026 - 10/09/2026 (EU residents) and 01/02/2026 - 31/05/2026 (non-EU residents). No OFA (additional learning requirements) exist for master's programmes - OFA and the 30 November 2026 TOLC-E/CEnT-S deadline apply only to the bachelor courses of the Economics area.
reserved_places_non_eu: [uncertain] No programme-specific number published in the documents consulted. The Avviso Aggiuntivo 2026/2027 for non-EU residents states that an annual quota of places reserved for non-EU resident students is set for every degree course and that the 2026/2027 quota is listed in 'Allegato n.1' to the notice ('Per ogni corso di studi e fissato annualmente un contingente di posti riservati agli studenti residenti nei Paesi extra UE. Il contingente per l'anno accademico 2026/2027 e consultabile nell'Allegato n.1 del presente Avviso.'). Allegato n.1 was not retrievable as a separate uniud.it document during this research, so the exact number of reserved non-EU seats for this LM-77 programme could not be verified. The named reserved-seat figures in the ECONOMIA Manifesto 2026/27 (e.g. 30 of 100 for Management & Business Analytics) refer to bachelor programmes only.
admin_seat_university: University of Udine (Universita degli Studi di Udine, UNIUD) is the sole administrative seat. Enrolment, tuition and student records are handled by UNIUD (Segreteria Studenti Economia, Via Tomadini 30, Udine). This is not an inter-university (interateneo) degree: the link with Carinthia University of Applied Sciences (CUAS, Austria) is an optional Double Degree carried out as Erasmus mobility, selected through a separate call published on the course web page, and does not change the administrative seat or the enrolment procedure.
course_status_flag: Active and fully operational. The ECONOMIA Manifesto degli studi 2026/27 lists 'International Marketing, Management and Organization, classe LM-77, sede di Udine' with 'Anni attivati: tutti' (all years activated). No 'ad esaurimento' (phasing-out) note applies to this programme - such notes appear in the same manifesto only for Economia Aziendale L-18 Ordinamento 2010 and Economia Aziendale LM-77 Ordinamento 2025.
language_requirements: English at CEFR B2 or equivalent is required, certified. Only certificates obtained within the last 5 years are valid and must clearly state the level achieved. Recognised certifications: Cambridge English Language Assessment; Trinity College London; IELTS; TOEFL; Pearson Edexcel - PTE Academic; Pearson General English; Oxford Test of English; LanguageCert International ESOL; Gatehouse Awards Classic; British Council - Aptis ESOL General; British Council - Aptis ESOL Advanced. Exemptions: applicants who completed a school programme taught in English (IB diplomas, multilingual schools, etc.) and native English speakers (per the UK gov English-language exemption list). A pre-evaluation application may be submitted without the certificate if the applicant is awaiting an exam or the issuing of the certificate, but obtaining it remains mandatory to complete enrolment. If a B2 certificate is absent, the competent Academic/Teaching Committee may assess English through an online interview. Italian language proficiency is NOT required for this programme, since it is taught entirely in English (the Italian B2/CLIQ certification requirement applies to courses taught in Italian). Applicants with an Italian degree must have B2-level English per the Manifesto; the course committee verifies advanced English ability, with exemption for a final degree mark >= 90/110.
english_level_exception: No exception - the standard B2 requirement applies to this programme. The only UNIUD English-level exception is for the Master's in Management Engineering, which requires B1 ('Per il corso di laurea magistrale in Management engineering, il livello di conoscenza della lingua inglese richiesto e il livello B1'). For partially English-taught courses the required level in both Italian and English remains B2 or equivalent. Note the separate programme-specific rule for this LM-77: the minimum GPA is 60% of the maximum possible bachelor grade, which is lower than the 3/4 (75%) applied to Industrial Engineering for Sustainable Manufacturing, Management Engineering and AI & Cybersecurity.
english_cert_validity_years: 5 years. 'Only certificates obtained within the last 5 years will be considered valid. Certificates must clearly indicate the achieved level.' / 'Saranno ritenute valide le certificazioni che non siano state conseguite da piu di 5 anni.' No programme-specific deviation from this general UNIUD rule.
teaching_language_partial_flag: Fully English. The programme is one of the five UNIUD master's degrees listed under 'List of Master's degree courses taught entirely in English' / 'Lista dei corsi di laurea magistrale erogati interamente in lingua inglese' in the Avviso Aggiuntivo 2026/2027. The Manifesto degli studi 2026/27 confirms 'Corso erogato in inglese'. There is no Italian-taught curriculum branch and no partial-English arrangement; the programme has a single curriculum (no tracks listed in the Manifesto). Only the mobility semester(s) at CUAS under the optional Double Degree are taught outside UNIUD, also in English.
application_deadline_eu: For EU-resident applicants holding a foreign qualification: the Elix-Forms pre-evaluation application must be submitted between 01/02/2026 and 10/09/2026 ('Applications for admission to master's degree courses taught in Italian and in English must be submitted on the Elix-Forms platform between 01/02/2026 and 10/09/2026'). Applicants holding an Italian bachelor's degree do not use Elix-Forms and instead apply directly through the immatricolazione window 9 July 2026 - 5 October 2026 at 12:00.
application_deadline_non_eu: For applicants resident in non-EU countries: the Elix-Forms pre-evaluation application window is 01/02/2026 - 31/05/2026 ('Le domande di accesso al corso di laurea magistrale erogato in lingua italiana e in lingua inglese devono essere presentate sulla piattaforma Elix-forms nel periodo compreso dal 01/02/2026 al 31/05/2026'). This closes more than three months earlier than the EU-resident deadline, in order to leave time for the Universitaly pre-enrolment and study-visa procedure.
universitaly_deadline: 30 June 2026. Non-EU resident applicants must create a digital profile on the UNIVERSITALY portal (https://www.universitaly.it/first-steps) and submit the digital PRE-ISCRIZIONE application for a University of Udine degree course for a.y. 2026/2027 by no later than 30 June 2026; pre-enrolment applications submitted after 30 June 2026 will not be evaluated ('entro e non oltre il 30 giugno 2026. Le domande di preiscrizione presentate dopo il 30 giugno 2026 non verranno valutate'). This is separate from and later than the 31/05/2026 Elix-Forms deadline: the UNIUD letter of eligibility obtained via Elix-Forms is the prerequisite for the Universitaly pre-enrolment and the visa request. Documents to attach on Universitaly: valid passport, photo, final/provisional bachelor's degree, and the B2 English certificate (for an English-taught course). UNIUD pre-enrolment does not guarantee a visa appointment or a visa - the visa is issued exclusively by the diplomatic-consular representation.
decision_timeline_days: 30 working days ('30 giorni lavorativi'). After submission of a complete pre-evaluation application with all documents and the paid fee, the file is forwarded to the Commissione didattica valutatrice (Academic Committee), which communicates the outcome by email within 30 working days from the submission date. For non-EU applicants the notice specifies that within those 30 working days the committee schedules the online selection interview and subsequently communicates the outcome.
enrolment_window: Immatricolazione applications for master's degrees are submitted from 9 July 2026 to 5 October 2026 at 12:00 ('Le domande d'immatricolazione ai corsi di laurea magistrale si presentano dal 9 luglio al 5 ottobre 2026 alle ore 12.00'). Late enrolment may be granted by the Rector for justified reasons up to 12:00 on 15 January 2027, by submitting a late-enrolment request with a EUR 16.00 revenue stamp (marca da bollo); no late request is needed for students who obtained their bachelor's degree after 5 October 2026. Students graduating in the extraordinary session (after 15 January 2027) may enrol in single courses under the 2026/27 fees notice and later have those exams validated on enrolment in the master's degree. Because the master's programme is accesso libero, there is no 'chronological order until seats run out' rule for it (that rule and the waiting-list mechanism apply to the accesso programmato bachelor courses of the Economics area). Enrolment is completed online on Esse3 (https://uniud.esse3.cineca.it), with mandatory upload of the required documents within the deadline and payment of the first instalment via PagoPA; documents must be uploaded within 30 days of Esse3 registration.
required_documents: Pre-evaluation on Elix-Forms (applicants with a foreign qualification, both EU and non-EU residents): a) foreign final or provisional university qualification (bachelor); b) list of completed exams / transcript of records / diploma supplement of that bachelor; c) descriptions of single subjects / syllabus of the foreign bachelor; d) valid passport; e) updated curriculum vitae; f) CIMEA Statements or Declaration of Value of the foreign bachelor's qualification; g) required language certification - this last item may be submitted after the online pre-evaluation but is required for the final enrolment procedure at UNIUD. Payment of the non-refundable EUR 20.00 pre-evaluation fee (via PagoPA, or bank transfer in specific cases) is part of a 'complete' application; incomplete or unpaid applications are not evaluated. Recognition of the foreign degree is done either through a Declaration of Value issued by the Italian Embassy/Consulate or through CIMEA statements requested on https://cimea-diplome.it (ARDI Statement of Correspondence available for Lisbon Recognition Convention countries, but the CIMEA Verification Statement must still be requested). Non-EU residents additionally upload on Universitaly: valid passport, photo, final/provisional university qualification and the B2 English certificate. Enrolment (immatricolazione) on Esse3: copy of identity document; copy of tax code (codice fiscale); passport-size photo; signed enrolment application; receipt of payment of the first fee instalment via PagoPA; parental authorisation if a minor; copy of the residence permit (permesso di soggiorno) for non-EU citizens; plus documentation of the curricular requirements (self-certification of exams, marks and SSD for Italian graduates) and, for foreign qualifications, the Declaration of Value or CIMEA attestation. Enrolment by post is not accepted. NOTE: Applicants with an Italian bachelor's degree do not use Elix-Forms and do not pay the EUR 20.00 pre-evaluation fee; they self-certify their exams, marks and SSDs before starting the online immatricolazione procedure.

uncertainty_notes: 1) Reserved non-EU places (contingente) for this specific programme could not be verified: the Avviso Aggiuntivo for non-EU residents refers to 'Allegato n.1', which was not retrievable as a separate uniud.it document; the seat figures visible in the ECONOMIA Manifesto 2026/27 concern bachelor courses only. 2) The outline note 'Minimum GPA: 60% of the maximum grade' is confirmed, but it applies only to applicants with a FOREIGN bachelor's degree (per the Avviso Aggiuntivo table). For Italian-degree applicants the Manifesto sets no minimum grade; the 90/110 threshold there is only an exemption from the verification interview, not a minimum admission mark. These two rules are frequently conflated and should be kept distinct. 3) The two Elix-Forms windows differ by residence, not by citizenship: 01/02/2026-10/09/2026 for applicants resident in EU countries, 01/02/2026-31/05/2026 for applicants resident in non-EU countries. Applicants holding an Italian bachelor's degree bypass Elix-Forms entirely and use the 9 July - 5 October 2026 immatricolazione window. 4) The Double Degree with Carinthia University of Applied Sciences (CUAS, Villach/Klagenfurt, Austria) is optional and is awarded through a separate internal selection published on the course web page, run under Erasmus mobility rules; it is not a joint/interateneo degree and does not affect admission to the LM-77 programme, whose sole administrative seat remains UNIUD. The specific CUAS selection call for 2026/27 was not located on uniud.it during this research. 5) Both the EU and non-EU notices state that admission decisions are communicated within 30 working days; the non-EU notice explicitly ties this to the scheduling of the online selection interview, while the EU notice for master's courses phrases it as communication of the outcome - in practice both routes involve the Admissions Committee online interview for this programme, as stated in its requirements table row. 6) No entrance test (TOLC-E / CEnT-S) and no OFA apply to this master's programme; the 30 November 2026 test deadline and the 6-point OFA threshold in the ECONOMIA Manifesto concern only the Economics-area bachelor programmes. 7) Tuition amounts themselves were not researched (excluded field bundle); only the official fees notice link is provided. The fees/reductions application deadline of 5 October 2026 is stated in the Manifesto.
